text:
Aisha Chen: Quick sync — Northbridge is planning a migration off HaloAPI and wants a 4-week POC to validate our connector and quantify cost/latency deltas. Primary asks: prompt parity, response shape, enterprise security questionnaire, and pricing impact. Can SEs + infra owners jump in?
Marco Li: On it. SE plan = run a response-diff harness + prompt-perf tests. Need sample traffic (typical ~1k req/day) and a short prompt set. Also confirm whether they use stateful sessions or just stateless calls.
Priya Nair: I can own the eval harness. Can someone drop sample logs + example responses from their current HaloAPI setup? Also what's the target latency? They mentioned <150ms p95 in the RFP.
Devon Patel: We can spin a dedicated dev pool for the POC. We'll need their CIDR block and peering window. Heads-up: HaloAPI bills in microburst token increments which will skew short-run cost estimates.
Lisa Grant: Pricing note — for the POC we can allocate credits. To model the delta I need an expected token/month estimate. If they project >2M tokens/month, we should propose reserved pricing.
Ellie Morris: Security checklist: send the enterprise questionnaire + SOC2 excerpts. Northbridge requires KMS integration, audit logs retention 1yr, and IP allowlist. @Aisha please confirm whether their legal will sign our standard DPA/NDA before data access.
Aisha Chen: NDA sent yesterday to their counsel, waiting signature. Attaching the short prompt set they shared in the RFP so SEs can start: 
---PROMPTS START---
1) "Summarize the user's message and extract intent + entities"
2) "Rewrite for formal tone, preserve meaning"
3) "Answer with a bulleted troubleshooting checklist"
---PROMPTS END---
Example request/response (HaloAPI):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.halo.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":120}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer AAA'
# response: {"id":"r_123","text":"TL;DR: ...","detected_entities":["billing","token"]}
```
Marco Li: Thanks — I'll run the harness and post a diff summary by EOD Friday. For prompt parity tests we'll instrument temperature/stop tokens and include alignment checks.
Priya Nair: Also add tokenization-level diffing — HaloAPI uses a slightly different tokenizer which will create small output deltas. I'll include a tokenized delta report for each prompt.
Devon Patel: Network ask: we need static egress IPs and their allowed inbound addresses. I'll open an infra ticket to reserve IPs and provision a dev pool (ETA ~48h once CIDR provided).
Lisa Grant: Rough POC cost after credits: ~$1.2k for 4 weeks assuming 500k tokens and a dedicated dev pool. I'll put a few scenarios in the shared pricing sheet.
Aisha Chen: Nice. Next steps: SEs start harness + diff, Ellie to send security questionnaire, finance to populate scenarios, infra to provision dev pool after CIDR. Check-in Tue 09:30 PT. :calendar:
deploy-bot: Environment scheduled: northbridge-poc -> dedicated-devpool-03 (provisioning started).
